# hadisst_subset.R

Download HadISST monthly SST from met office, subset by lon/lat/years


```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

```{r libraries}

library(ncdf4)        # For handling netCDF files    
library(lubridate)    # For date manipulation
library(rerddap)
library(tidyverse)    # For data manipulation and plotting
library(here)

library(terra)
library(R.utils)
```

```{r set directories}
# Set directories
project_dir <- here::here()
output_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "0_data", "01_data_raw")
```

```{r load data}
df_final <- read_csv(file.path(project_dir, "0_data", "02_data_clean", "rls_se_aus_clean.csv"))
df_final_iso <- read_csv( file.path(project_dir,"0_data/02_data_clean/rls_lhi_clean.csv"))
df_total <- read_csv(file.path(project_dir,"0_data/02_data_clean/rls_combo_clean.csv"))

```


```{r get population coords}
lon_breaks <- seq(135.5, 160.5, by = 1)
lat_breaks <- seq(-45.5, -10.5, by = 1)

lon_labels <- lon_breaks[-length(lon_breaks)] + 0.5
lat_labels <- lat_breaks[-length(lat_breaks)] + 0.5

latlon <- df_total |>
  mutate(pop_lon = cut(longitude, breaks = lon_breaks,labels = lon_labels,include.lowest = TRUE),
        pop_lat = cut(latitude, breaks = lat_breaks,labels = lat_labels,include.lowest = TRUE),
        pop_lon = as.numeric(as.character(pop_lon)),
        pop_lat = as.numeric(as.character(pop_lat)),
        population = paste(pop_lat, pop_lon, sep = "_")) |>
  filter( !is.na(pop_lat),
          !is.na(pop_lon))|>
  distinct(population, pop_lat, pop_lon) |>
  transmute(population = population,
    latmin = pop_lat - 0.5,
    latmax = pop_lat + 0.5,
    lonmin = pop_lon - 0.5,
    lonmax = pop_lon + 0.5) |>
  arrange(latmin, lonmin)

#write_csv(latlon, "0_data/01_data_raw/population_sites_HadISST.csv")
```

```{r download directly from met office and subset}


# Download and open HadISST SST
download_hadisst <- function() {

  gz_path <- tempfile(fileext = ".nc.gz")
  nc_path <- sub("\\.gz$", "", gz_path)

  download.file(
    "https://www.metoffice.gov.uk/hadobs/hadisst/data/HadISST_sst.nc.gz",
    gz_path,
    mode = "wb"
  )

  R.utils::gunzip(
    gz_path,
    destname = nc_path,
    remove = TRUE
  )

  sst <- terra::rast(nc_path, subds = "sst")

  list(sst = sst, nc_path = nc_path)
}


# Extract monthly mean SST for one population
subset_population_sst <- function(
  sst,
  population,
  latmin,
  latmax,
  lonmin,
  lonmax,
  years
) {

  sst_crop <- terra::crop(
    sst,
    terra::ext(lonmin, lonmax, latmin, latmax)
  )

  dates <- as.Date(terra::time(sst_crop))

  keep <- lubridate::year(dates) %in% years

  sst_crop <- sst_crop[[keep]]
  dates <- dates[keep]

  tibble::tibble(
    population = population,
    date = dates,
    year = lubridate::year(dates),
    month = lubridate::month(dates),
    sst_mean = as.numeric(
      terra::global(sst_crop, "mean", na.rm = TRUE)[, 1]
    )
  )
}


# Download HadISST once, extract each population, and save CSV files
get_hadisst_for_populations <- function(
  populations,
  years,
  latlon,
  out_dir = file.path(project_dir, "0_data", "HadISST_subsets")
) {

  dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  tmp <- download_hadisst()
  on.exit(file.remove(tmp$nc_path), add = TRUE)

  latlon |>
    dplyr::filter(population %in% populations) |>
    purrr::pmap_dfr(
      function(population, latmin, latmax, lonmin, lonmax, ...) {

        out <- subset_population_sst(
          sst = tmp$sst,
          population = population,
          latmin = latmin,
          latmax = latmax,
          lonmin = lonmin,
          lonmax = lonmax,
          years = years
        )

        readr::write_csv(
          out,
          file.path(
            out_dir,
            paste0(
              "HadISST_sst_mean_",
              population, "_",
              min(years), "-", max(years),
              ".csv"
            )
          )
        )

        out
      }
    )
}

# ============================
# usage
# ============================
hadisst_sst <- get_hadisst_for_populations(
  populations = unique(latlon$population),
  years = 1992:2025,
  latlon = latlon
)

write_csv(hadisst_sst, file = file.path(output_dir,paste("HadISST_all_pops_monthly_mean.csv" )))
```


```{r combine with rls data}
hadisst_sst <- read_csv(file.path(output_dir,paste("HadISST_all_pops_monthly_mean.csv" )))

#check all years have all months
d <- hadisst_sst |>
  count(population, year, name = "n_months")

# annual mean sst
hadisst_sst_annual <- hadisst_sst |> 
  group_by(population, year) |> 
  summarise(sst_mean_annual = mean(sst_mean)) |> 
  ungroup()

df_total <- df_total |> 
  left_join(hadisst_sst_annual, by = c("population", "year"))
df_final <- df_final |> 
  left_join(hadisst_sst_annual, by = c("population", "year"))
df_final_iso <- df_final_iso |> 
  left_join(hadisst_sst_annual, by = c("population", "year"))
```
